_note: Statutory Proof Substitution Matrix designed by Member 5 under Section 12 of the Disaster Management Act 2005. When documents are destroyed by disaster, field officers are legally required to accept these certified alternative proofs.
aadhaar: Voter ID (EPIC), Ration Card or any government photo identity card
Attestation certificate issued by Gram Panchayat Pradhan, Ward Councillor, or Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
Electronic demographic match via mobile OTP or Aadhaar Seva Kendra biometric printout (auto-drafted request available)
Neighbor corroboration countersigned by Panchayat Secretary
ration_card: Electronic beneficiary record in the National Food Security Act (NFSA) / State Food & Supplies PDS dealer register
Panchayat Pradhan / Ward Member family composition certificate
Ration dealer token slip or ePDS portal digital beneficiary extract
land_record: Digital RoR / Khatian / 7/12 / Patta extract from state land portals (Banglarbhumi, Bhulekh, Dharitree, AnyROR, Patta Chitta)
Emergency certificate from the Block Land & Land Reforms Office (BL&LRO) / Tehsildar / Talathi / Patwari
Geo-tagged and timestamped photographs of the damaged agricultural plot submitted through Aapke Liye
Adjoining plot owners' joint affidavit countersigned by the Gram Panchayat
bank_passbook: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) verification from NPCI Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Account Mapper
Emergency single-page bank statement or letter from local bank branch / Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra)
Cancelled cheque or digital screenshot from Mobile/Internet banking / UPI app profile
house_ownership: Gram Panchayat property tax receipt, electricity utility bill, or water connection receipt
Geo-tagged, time-stamped damage photos of the dwelling captured via Aapke Liye
Pradhan / Revenue Inspector joint site inspection panchnama
Joint neighbor declaration affirming physical possession and occupancy prior to disaster
voter_id: Online Electoral Roll extract from Election Commission of India (ECI) voter portal (voters.eci.gov.in)
Aadhaar card, Ration Card, or MNREGA Job Card
Gram Panchayat or Revenue Inspector identity certificate
death_certificate: First Information Report (FIR) or Station Diary entry from local Police Station
Inquest report and Post-Mortem report from District / Sub-Divisional Hospital
Joint enquiry certificate by Block Development Officer (BDO) / Tehsildar and Medical Officer confirming death due to disaster
disability_certificate: UDID (Unique Disability ID) digital card or Swavlamban portal registration extract
Emergency medical examination report by Chief Medical Officer (CMO) or Government Medical Board
Local Primary Health Centre (PHC) medical officer disability certificate
_default: Attestation certificate by the Gram Panchayat Pradhan, Village Administrative Officer (VAO), or Revenue Inspector
Geo-tagged, time-stamped damage photographs submitted through the Aapke Liye mobile app
Two neighbor attestations confirming residency and loss
